reviews.Author: Cargo
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 28, 2026
reviews.Text: Maldon Salt is a superior chef’s product our family has used for many years. It’s terrific attributes are readily noticed and long remembered. This said, our recent order was not properly packed and arrived late with the content spilled and contaminated. The Maldon company flatly refused to replace the shipment and directed me back to Amazon. For such a frequently ordered and modestly priced item the response of this merchant is unacceptable. Sadly, after so many years we are looking for a new supplier.
reviews.Title: Great Product But Disasterous Customer Service

reviews.Author: V. Melton
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on July 23, 2026
reviews.Text: Good product. But carboard outer box was crushed and pulled apart in 3 places. I am going to keep since inner cellophane holdind is still sealed. Don’t know who was hard on packaging.

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 1, 2026
reviews.Text: Is the salt good? Yes. Is it flaky? No. At least not up to my standard. For a company that is supposed to be “renowned for its distinct pyramid-shaped flakes” I was beyond disappointed to open the box and nothing but regular crushed salt. Absolutely ZERO pyramid shaped flakes. NONE!!!! and yes, I went through the entire bag because I was in complete disbelief that there was not a single large flake of salt. Apparently you cannot get what the company is renowned for despite buying the product that is supposed to contain it. My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined.
reviews.Title: “Large flakes” LIE
